gbm_population_evidence.quote: A Randomized Phase II Trial of Concurrent Low-dose Bevacizumab and HSRT Versus Bevacizumab Alone for Glioblastoma at First Recurrence: HSCK-005
Original histopathologically proven diagnosis World Health Organization (WHO) Grade 3/4 glioma;

candidate_evidence.quote: IV 5mg/kg (experimental group) or 10mg/kg (comparison group) every two weeks until disease progression.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Low-dose Bevacizumab With HSRT vs BVZ Alone for GBM at First Recurrence

role_evidence.quote: IV 5mg/kg (experimental group) or 10mg/kg (comparison group) every two weeks until disease progression.
To establish an improvement in 6-month pfs in recurrent glioblastoma patients receiving low-dose bevacizumab and re-irradiation compared with patients receiving bevacizumab alone.

agents.drug_class_hint: anti-VEGF monoclonal antibody; established GBM therapy

coder_notes: Bevacizumab (established GBM therapy, D6) at a lower dose (5 mg/kg) with re-irradiation (HSRT) vs standard-dose bevacizumab (10 mg/kg) alone; dose differs between arms, so rule 6 (established_therapy_experiment) in the experimental arm; in the 'Bevacizumab' active comparator arm its role is control_comparator. No pharmacological candidate. Eligibility allows WHO grade 3/4 glioma while title specifies glioblastoma; coded mixed_glioma_gbm_named. Conditions list only 'Glioma; Recurrent Glioma'.
